scenes.vo: Last night, my landlady asked if it had said my name yet. I didn't sleep much after that.
On the second night, at three AM exactly, the knocking came again. Three slow knocks.
Then a voice I knew. Mrs. Dorsey, sweet and tired. Open up, dear. I brought you something warm.
My hand was on the lock when my phone buzzed. A message from Mrs. Dorsey. Out of town until FRIDAY. Don't open the door.
The knocking stopped. The light under my door went DARK, like something had knelt down and pressed its face to the gap.
I stood there frozen, staring at my screen. Then the voice said: I know you're READING my message.
